question: For the SAME original tagged animal, does the signed ERA5 shortwave anomaly association with night/day observed GPS displacement and cos/sin Sun-relative travel differ between the two q-coverage-ranked original grid×year contexts?
guardrails: Original Movebank provider UUID, bytes and MD5 and every original taxon q/daylength mean/count must replay BEFORE ANY fresh ERA5 request.
Original first v0 source gridyear/animal/day selection and 1h apparent solar-clock thresholds remain unchanged; no sign-selected new context.
For each original selected context, match first v0 q-qualified animal and day counts, original solar steps, original ERA5 provider SHA256, original source mean slopes and source animals.
If original ERA5 provider response SHA differs from frozen first v0 result, return WEATHER_VERSION_HOLD; no biological paired effect computed or weather model adjusted.
Pair individual identities only in ephemeral analysis RAM and WITHIN the same original study and taxon. Never publish tag IDs, coordinates, exact observations or per-tag slopes.
Both context ranks are assigned by original q sampling support: rank2 MINUS rank1; neither high-minus-low radiation nor chronologically before-after.
No source substitutions, unsupported-to-zero recoding, source-level p-values from pseudo-independent GPS steps, historical result modification or reclassification of old external nonreplication.

estimands.source_unit: one original published study; native taxon is a within-study group; paired original tagged individual is the unit for context differences
estimands.per_axis: Original v0 individual slope context 2 minus context 1; require >=5 original tagged animals with defined slopes in both contexts, otherwise UNAVAILABLE.
estimands.joint: Original tagged animals with sun_cos, sun_sin, q slopes in both contexts; optionally Spearman delta_q vs delta_sun_cos/sin when n>=5 and nondegenerate.
estimands.source_animal_bootstrap: 2000 deterministic paired original individual resamples, 2.5/97.5 percentile, source-conditional descriptive not general world

interpretations: An aggregate context slope sign reversal is not a repeated individual's slope reversal without paired evidence.
Context is selected on GPS sampling, not randomly assigned climate or solar irradiance.
Same tagged animals may have different season, route, collar duty cycle and microhabitat between two selected gridyears; causal ecology is not identified.
A failed source weather SHA replay means weather version changed or serialized provider response changed; never silently substitute new exposure.
This is post-result sensitivity, not confirmatory evidence of new global climate-dependent movement behavior.
